purpose: Bitwise repeatability of fused SDPA backends and HT_COMPILE=1 on sm_120 under hypertrain.trainer determinism settings (use_deterministic_algorithms=True)
method: Fresh process per run (4 runs: p1,p2 without Python headers so Inductor failed to build; p3,p4 with C_INCLUDE_PATH set), 3 in-process repeats each, seed 0, loss=sum(o.float()^2); sha256 over raw bytes of out,dq,dk,dv. Timing = mean of 10 fwd+bwd after 3 warmups.
